title: Unreal Berries Cranberry & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Cranberry & Raspberry from Unreal Berries is a fabulously fruity blend of two perfectly paired flavours. On the inhale, your tastebuds can indulge on the sharp, crisp tang of fresh cranberries, while on the inhale, the juicy, ruby tang of raspberries delivers a vibrantly fruity finish. Shortfill bottles from Unreal Berries E-liquids offer the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Unreal Berries are a range of 100ml shortfills that are made in the UK by Unreal e-liquids, a brand that are famous for their fruit flavours. They’ve paired only the very Berriest flavours in each blend for a deliciously natural tasting berry vape experience. Unreal shortfills come in 100ml shortfill bottles with space for one or two nicotine shots to let you tailor your e-liquid’s nicotine strength to your exact preference.
